verified_good_products.title: Warehouse Prefabricated Steel Building
verified_good_products.description:
Kishore PEB has done hundreds of warehouses for rural godowns, factory godowns, seed godowns, and many more. Having inhouse design and fabrication infrastructure, we can deliver the customized ware houses across india. We understand your requirement for warehouse and customize the shed as per your specific requirements. 

Every warehouse is unique based on the material stored in it. Each warehouse has to be designed based on the requirement of 
1. Available land,
2. optimum width
3. optimum length, 
4. set back for fire protection
5. height of building based on the product ot be stored
6. Ventilation
7. Insulation
8. Lighting
9. Security with brickwall 
10. Opening to be given for easy access 
11. Height of floor
12. Color of roof material , color of cladding material


and many more attributes like the location of the shed, windspeed, seismic zone, temperature etc.

We are here to help you decide on the requirements and give you best possible economical soluitons without compromising the stability and utility of the building.

Do call us for more info and together lets build your dream into reality.
